name: Myr
description: A myr that monitors other myr.

description_citations.work: Friday Night Magic 2009: card flavor text
description_citations.text: Friday Night Magic 2009: card flavor text (Friday Night Magic 2009, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Memnarch created the myr with dependability, controllability and disposability in mind.
timeline.quote: Memnarch created the myr with three qualities in mind: dependability, controllability, and disposability.

citation.text: Myr Moonvessel (Darksteel, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Memnarch is quoted on the equilibrium of his experimental myr population.
timeline.quote: As the experimental population grows, so do the number of myr. It's a perfect equilibrium.

citation.text: Genesis Chamber (Darksteel, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jace, mad, commands her to help him; Tamiyo shields her mind and uses the story Original to calm his thoughts.
timeline.quote: But her mind withdrew to a far-off castle, and the winds could not reach her.

citation.text: "Stories and Endings" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2016.

relations.quote: Memnarch created the myr with three qualities in mind

citation.text: Myr Moonvessel (Darksteel, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: In Tamiyo's story, the myr were lost when their creator Memnarch was gone.
relations.quote: With their creator gone, the creatures known as the myr were lost.

citation.text: "Stories and Endings" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2016.
